page_title: Calc-Ready Summer 2025 or Beyond | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
sentence: Students who do not receive direct admission into Engineering, but are admitted into UESP or other majors, are welcome to satisfy the pre-calculus requirement prior to starting coursework at OSU and switch into an engineering major.

page_title: Calc-Ready Summer 2025 or Beyond | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
sentence: Students can satisfy the pre-calculus requirement by successfully completing MTH 111Z and MTH 112Z with a C- or better and maintaining a 2.50 OSU GPA or higher.

page_title: Calc-Ready Summer 2025 or Beyond | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
sentence: Once a student has met these criteria, they will be allowed to change their major to engineering the following term.

page_title: Calc-Ready Summer 2025 or Beyond | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
sentence: If you haven't taken Pre-Calculus or Calculus and are not currently taking either course, you can be admitted to OSU as an undeclared student initially and get yourself calculus-ready - either before you enroll or after you enroll, at which point you may change your major to Engineering.

page_title: Calc-Ready Summer 2025 or Beyond | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
sentence: If you haven't taken Pre-Calculus or Calculus and are not currently taking either course, you can be admitted to OSU as an undeclared student initially and get yourself calculus-ready - either before you enroll or after you enroll, at which point you may change your major to Engineering.

page_title: Calc-Ready Summer 2025 or Beyond | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
sentence: Provide CLEP, AP or IB scores that demonstrate pre-calculus proficiency (where OSU awards credit for MTH 112Z or higher based on student score)

page_title: Calc-Ready Summer 2025 or Beyond | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
sentence: If you enroll at OSU and are not ready to take Calculus right away, you can meet requirements to declare an Engineering degree by successfully completing MTH 111Z and MTH 112Z with a C or better at OSU and maintain a 2.50 OSU GPA or higher.

page_title: Calc-Ready Summer 2025 or Beyond | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
sentence: Once MTH 112z is completed, you may work with your advisor to change your major to Engineering.

page_title: Calc-Ready Summer 2025 or Beyond | Undergraduate Admissions | Oregon State University
sentence: If you end up with a lower grade you could be asked to begin as an undeclared student (or another non-engineering major of your choice) until you have met the requirements outlined above to declare a major in Engineering.
